title: How FlyDubai Passengers and Crew Averted Disaster After Pilot Was Stabbed During Flight
partialText: A badly wounded Indian pilot managed to unlock the cockpit door. Four Israeli men teamed up to overwhelm an attacker and avert disaster.

title: Indian Pilot Stabbed on FlyDubai Flight Recalls Sudden Attack
partialText: Capt. Smit Machchhar, who was stabbed by his co-pilot midair between Dubai and Tel Aviv, said he “had to act” to prevent a crash despite serious injuries.

title: Airlines Set to Bring Israelis Back From U.A.E. After FlyDubai Cockpit Attack
partialText: The attack, on a flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv, halted the only direct service between the two cities since the war in Iran disrupted air traffic.

title: Why Were 4 Pilots Aboard FlyDubai Flight 1073?
partialText: After the co-pilot stabbed the captain, two pilots who were seated in the cabin intervened alongside passengers and safely landed the Boeing 737 in Saudi Arabia.

title: Man Accused of Sex Assault Seeks to Expunge Cornell’s Finding of Related Violation
partialText: A panel found the man responsible for attempted sexual exploitation, barred him from contact with the woman and required him to take a class and write a paper.

title: How The New York Times Is Reporting on the Cornell Rape Investigation
partialText: Times editors explore the thinking behind our coverage of the explosive allegations that have roiled a campus and the country.

title: Christa Pike Was Unconscious and on Ventilator After Execution Attempt
partialText: The Tennessee inmate was brought to a hospital with burned and blistered arms after an unsuccessful attempt at lethal injection, her lawyers said in a court filing.

title: U.S. and Allies Agree to Release Diesel Reserves as Prices Soar
partialText: The Group of 7, which includes Britain, France and Japan, announced the release of 100 million barrels over four months, effective immediately.

title: Sales of Hulking Pickups and S.U.V.s Sag as Fuel Prices Soar
partialText: Sales of big pickup trucks and sport utility vehicles have dipped as more Americans buy hybrids and smaller cars.

title: National Science Foundation Diverted $1.4 Billion in Science Funds Mandated by Congress
partialText: The move, affecting about one-fifth of the National Science Foundation’s primary research budget, is the latest sign of how the White House is asserting more control over grants.

title: Republicans Pull Money From North Carolina Senate Race As Midterm Prospects Dim
partialText: As the Republicans try to hold their majority, the Senate Leadership Fund is diverting resources to Kansas, which has become a growing concern for the party.

title: AIPAC Is Spending Millions to Elect Friends. It’s Also Making Enemies.
partialText: The American Israel Public Affairs Committee has increasingly become a campaign issue unto itself. Some candidates have worn opposition from AIPAC as a badge of honor or made a point of rejecting the group’s support.

title: Flurry of Lawsuits Shows Both Parties Preparing for Post-Election Challenges
partialText: Republicans are using the courts to hunt for noncitizen voters. Democrats worry the G.O.P. is trying make it harder for eligible voters to cast ballots — and paving the way to try to toss valid election results.

title: California Sues to Block Trump From Weakening Fuel Economy Rules
partialText: The lawsuit is the 97th the state has filed against the Trump administration over the past year and a half.

title: Powerful Wildfires Require a New Approach, California Report Finds
partialText: A report on the fires that devastated the Los Angeles area in early 2025 recommended that local governments take a broader approach to preparedness and emergency response.

title: He Wrote the Book on the Sedgwick ‘Family Disease,’ and Succumbed to It
partialText: John Sedgwick was born into an illustrious family, but privilege was only part of the story.

title: Ukraine Reports First Combat Use of Its Own Ballistic Missile
partialText: While the missile fired on Thursday has a limited range, Kyiv is developing a larger weapon that could strike Moscow.

title: Russia Is Planning Its Most Powerful Blow Yet to Try to Freeze Ukraine
partialText: Ukraine showed European partners what it said were intercepted Russian plans to cut off major cities from power, heat and water this winter.

title: Student Protests Rattle France as Police Clashes Bring Blockades and Tear Gas
partialText: Days of unrest have affected more than 1,000 schools across France as high school students push for better standards.

title: Trump Is Getting Desperate. It Shows.
partialText: The Justice Department is trawling to find perpetrators on whom to pin conspiracies. Ordinary citizens are being ensnared.

title: Is the World Getting Uglier?
partialText: The modern right has a theory of beauty. Does the left?

title: Did You Buy $TRUMP Coin? Tell Us Your Experience.
partialText: We want to hear from people who bought the $TRUMP memecoin, no matter the reason, and whether they made or lost money.

title: Missouri Man Discovers Michael McDonald of the Doobie Brothers Is His Biological Father
partialText: Michael Goessling’s first phone call with his biological father brought a shock: He was speaking to Michael McDonald of the Doobie Brothers.
